title: Ultimate Oysters Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla with oysters adding a touch of luxury. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
2. Meanwhile, melt the Mustardy Butter in a separate pan over low heat.
3. Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with Egyptian Feta Cheese.
4. Place 3 oysters on half of the tortilla, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
5. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the oysters and cheese.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is lightly browned and the cheese is melted.
7. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also lightly browned.
8. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and oysters.
9. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately.
